_comment: Watchlist tiers for the daily MCP drift monitor. Kept SEPARATE from servers.json on purpose: the collector and toolprint read only servers.json['mcpServers'], so tagging lives here and cannot affect the live config. Classification is by the actual package each entry runs (see servers.json args), verified 2026-09-27.
provenance: frozen = the @modelcontextprotocol reference servers that have been moved to modelcontextprotocol/servers-archived (confirmed against the servers repo, 2026-09-27); reference = the active steering-group reference servers; vendor-community = third-party vendor and community servers.

reference.description: Actively maintained MCP steering-group reference servers. Churn is expected here; it is the baseline for 'normal' change.

frozen.description: Archived/deprecated reference servers (moved to modelcontextprotocol/servers-archived). CONTROL GROUP: these should not change. Any drift here is a signal that something upstream (a dependency, a re-publish, a shared SDK) moved, not normal maintenance.

vendor-community.description: Third-party vendor and community servers, where real capability change is most likely to appear.
